issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: CoreSpeed
products.tagline: One MCP for everything your agents need: apps, memory, tools
products.summaryZh: 一个MCP满足智能体所需的一切：应用、记忆、工具
products.descriptionZh: CoreSpeed 是面向智能体的操作系统。一次连接应用，即可将你的账户以及共享或私有记忆带入 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 及其他 MCP 智能体。每个应用支持多个账户，包括 X，并内置网页搜索、社交研究和媒体生成。CoreSpeed 保管应用凭证。预算、活动日志和 Smart Approval（测试版）让智能体保持受控。规划中：Agent Drive、Mail、Pay、沙箱等。你的智能体所需的一切，通过一个 MCP 端点实现。
products.description: CoreSpeed is an operating system for agents. Connect apps once and bring your accounts and shared or private memory to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP agents. Use multiple accounts per app, including X, with web search, social research and media generation built in. CoreSpeed holds app credentials. Budgets, activity logs and Smart Approval (beta) keep agents in check. Planned: Agent Drive, Mail, Pay, sandboxes, and more. Everything your agents need, through one MCP endpoint.

products.name: Smooth Recorder
products.tagline: Mac screen recordings that look edited when you hit stop
products.summaryZh: Mac 屏幕录制，停止时看起来就像剪辑过一样
products.descriptionZh: Smooth Recorder 是一款原生 Mac 应用，适用于演示和教程。它会在你点击的位置放大画面，平滑光标移动，在 Mac 上添加字幕，并将所有内容置于美观的背景之上。截图也具备同样的功能。
products.description: Smooth Recorder is a native Mac app for demos and tutorials. It zooms in where you click, smooths your cursor, adds captions on your Mac and puts it all on a nice background. Screenshots get the same features.

products.name: Blume 2.0
products.tagline: The open-source docs framework for humans and agents
products.summaryZh: 面向人类与智能体的开源文档框架
products.descriptionZh: 快速、AI就绪、零配置。将Markdown放入文件夹，即可发布生产级文档站点，无需编写或维护任何应用样板代码。永久免费且开源。
products.description: Fast, AI-ready, and zero-config. Drop Markdown into a folder and ship a production-grade docs site with no app boilerplate to write or maintain. Free and open source, forever.

products.name: DocsAlot MCP Connector
products.tagline: Maintain your help-center by asking Claude, Cursor or Codex
products.summaryZh: 通过询问 Claude、Cursor 或 Codex 来维护你的帮助中心
products.descriptionZh: 从 Claude、Codex 或任何兼容的 MCP 客户端创建和更新你的知识库。让 DocsAlot 添加页面、修正错误或改进你的帮助中心。它会找到相关内容、进行修改、创建新版本并发布，全部在你现有的工作流程中完成。查看用户在帮助中心提出了哪些问题，发现缺失的内容，并利用这些洞察改进文档、决定下一步构建什么。
products.description: Create and update your knowledge base from Claude, Codex, or any compatible MCP client. Ask DocsAlot to add a page, fix an error, or improve your help center. It finds the relevant content, makes changes, creates a new version, and publishes, all from your existing workflow. See what questions users ask in your help center, discover what’s missing, and use those insights to improve your docs and decide what to build next.

products.name: ChatGPT Space
products.tagline: Create, collaborate, and build together with AI in Space
products.summaryZh: 在空间中与AI一起创建、协作和构建
products.descriptionZh: ChatGPT Space 是一个共享画布，用于与 AI 一起创作、规划和协作。添加链接、文件和想法，构建一个持续生长的上下文来源，然后与 ChatGPT 一起将它们转化为计划、文档、应用等——让团队在同一处保持同步。
products.description: ChatGPT Space is a shared canvas for creating, planning, and collaborating with AI. Add links, files, and ideas to build a living source of context, then work with ChatGPT to turn them into plans, docs, apps, and more - keeping your team aligned in one place.

products.name: opensend.cc
products.tagline: The open source email platform that runs on your server
products.summaryZh: 在你的服务器上运行的开源电子邮件平台
products.descriptionZh: opensend.cc 是一个运行在你服务器上的开源邮件平台。它通过你自己的 AWS 账户发送邮件，因此你的域名、数据和发件人声誉都归你所有。你获得 REST API 和 SDK、SMTP、模板、群发、自动化、受众、webhook 和日志。一条命令即可安装。没有按邮件计费，没有功能限制。已经在用 Resend？改两行代码，保留你的代码。
products.description: opensend.cc is an open source email platform that runs on your server. It sends through your own AWS account, so your domain, your data and your sender reputation stay yours. You get a REST API and SDK, SMTP, templates, broadcasts, automations, audiences, webhooks and logs. One command installs it. No per-email pricing, no feature gates. Already on Resend? Change two lines and keep your code.

products.name: Octri.dev
products.tagline: Generate customizable Docs, SDKs, MCP server, and monitoring
products.summaryZh: 生成可定制的文档、SDK、MCP服务器和监控。
products.descriptionZh: 上传 OpenAPI 规范，Octri 即可生成完全可定制的文档站点、十种语言的高质量客户端 SDK（TypeScript、Python、Go、Rust、Ruby、PHP、Java、Kotlin、Swift、Dart），以及一个 MCP 服务器，让 AI 代理能够调用你的 API。新增功能：每个 SDK 都会回传自身的生产环境错误，让你在用户提交工单之前就发现集成故障。GitHub 同步会在每次合并时重新生成所有内容。
products.description: Upload an OpenAPI spec and Octri generates a fully customizable documentation site, high-quality client SDKs in ten languages (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Dart) and an MCP server so AI agents can call your API. The new part: every SDK reports its own production errors back, so you see integration failures before your users file tickets. GitHub sync regenerates everything on every merge.

products.name: Pass Designer
products.tagline: Design Apple Wallet passes and see the real card
products.summaryZh: 设计Apple Wallet凭证并查看真实卡片
products.descriptionZh: 无论你是为本地健身中心、小型音乐场馆、全球航空公司还是全国性咖啡连锁店创建凭证，Pass Designer 都能让你轻松制作和预览体现你业务特色的凭证。
products.description: Whether you’re creating passes for a local fitness center, a small music venue, a global airline, or a national coffee chain, Pass Designer makes it easy to craft and preview passes that reflect your business.

products.name: WikiFix for Confluence
products.tagline: Find and fix issues in your knowledge base
products.summaryZh: 在你的知识库中查找并修复问题
products.descriptionZh: WikiFix 监控你的知识库，发现相互矛盾的页面、重复内容和孤立页面等问题，并在你批准后一键修复，让你的团队能够信任他们读到或从 AI 听到的内容。
products.description: WikiFix monitors your KB for issues like contradicting pages, duplicates and orphans, and fixes them in one click once you approve, so your team can trust what it reads or hears from AI.

products.name: Thinking Orbs
products.tagline: Animated AI Status Indicator Component Library for React
products.summaryZh: 用于React的动画AI状态指示器组件库
products.descriptionZh: 一个 React 组件库，提供带动画的 AI 智能体状态光球。思考、搜索、压缩等状态一应俱全，每个状态和变体都经过细致打磨。
products.description: A React component library of animated AI agent status orbs. Thinking, searching, compacting and more, built with attention to detail on every state and variant.

products.name: Sellio
products.tagline: AI customer support in one shared inbox powered by AI agents
products.summaryZh: AI客户支持，汇聚于一个由AI代理驱动的共享收件箱
products.descriptionZh: AI客户支持，一个共享收件箱：实时聊天、WhatsApp、Instagram、Telegram和电子邮件。AI客服基于你的文档训练，还提供工单和分析功能。
products.description: AI customer support in one shared inbox: live chat, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, and email. AI agents trained on your docs, plus tickets and analytics.

products.name: Sente
products.tagline: Talk to your coding agent
products.summaryZh: 与你的编码代理对话
products.descriptionZh: 一个可以对话的编程智能体——在终端或手机上。1. 双向语音。朗读一句话（约 10 秒）即可录入你的声音。同意优先；删除键由你掌控。2. 一个账号可用 404 个模型——Claude、GPT、Gemini、DeepSeek 等。兼容 OpenAI 和 Anthropic。3. MIT 开源：github.com/yukihamada/sente 日本构建：东京区域，日元计费。坦诚的限制：按量计费，并非无限。每月额度；超出后充值。我们绝不克隆不属于你的声音。
products.description: A coding agent you can talk to — in your terminal or on your phone. 1. Voice, both ways. Read one sentence (~10 sec) to enroll your voice. Consent-first; the delete key is yours. 2. 404 models on one account — Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and more. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible. 3. MIT open source: github.com/yukihamada/sente Japan-built: Tokyo region, JPY billing. Honest limits: metered, not unlimited. Monthly credits; top up if you go over. We never clone a voice that isn't yours.

products.name: LaunchReel
products.tagline: claude design but for editing professional videos faster.
products.summaryZh: Claude的设计，但用于更快地剪辑专业视频。
products.descriptionZh: LaunchReel 是一个 Claude Code 插件，帮你制作视频：面向真实产品的发布影片和演示，以代码形式从你的仓库生成；以及从原始录像中剪辑出的口播短片。Claude 负责干活；LaunchReel 提供导演手册、原创音乐、配音，以及一个供你自己剪辑的工作室。可导出 16:9 或 9:16，最高 4K。
products.description: LaunchReel is a Claude Code plugin that makes your videos: launch films and demos for your real product, written as code from your repo, and talking-head reels cut from your raw recordings. Claude does the work; LaunchReel adds a director's playbook, original music, voiceover and a studio to edit it yourself. Export 16:9 or 9:16, up to 4K.

products.name: TinyFolder
products.tagline: App folders for your Mac Dock, designed your way
products.summaryZh: 为你的Mac Dock设计的应用文件夹，随心所欲。
products.descriptionZh: Mac 的 Dock 没有应用文件夹，而自 macOS Tahoe 起也没有了启动台。TinyFolder 把一文件夹的应用直接放进你的 Dock：点一下即可在图标上方展开。它的图标由其中的应用构成，其余部分由你设计——玻璃、颜色或纹理、布局、图标大小、标签，以及雪花、熔岩等动态效果——均可在实时预览中调整。Mac App Store 免费下载。
products.description: The Mac Dock has no app folders, and since macOS Tahoe there's no Launchpad either. TinyFolder puts a folder of apps right in your Dock: one click opens it above the tile. Its icon is built from the apps inside, and you design the rest – glass, color or texture, layouts, icon size, labels, living effects like snow and lava – in a live preview. Free on the Mac App Store.

products.name: Rival Workshop
products.tagline: A bookshelf app to manage every skill your agents read
products.summaryZh: 一个用于管理你的代理所阅读的每项技能的书架应用
products.descriptionZh: Workshop 应用会把仓库里的每项技能显示为书架上的书：书脊就是 Claude Code、Codex 或 Cursor 在每次任务前读取的内容，书立则标记每项技能的结束位置。你可以关闭技能、让它们仅在收到请求时运行、用 Claude Code 重写它们，并在安全检查后从网上添加优质技能。一条 node 命令，即可在你的电脑上运行。包含 150 项可编辑技能和 Brief。一次性付款：2026 年 10 月 31 日（太平洋时间晚上 11:59）前 79 美元，之后 149 美元。
products.description: The Workshop app shows every skill in your repo as a book on a shelf: the spine is what Claude Code, Codex or Cursor reads before every task, and a bookend marks where each one stops. Switch skills off, make them run only when asked, rewrite them with Claude Code, and add good ones from the web after a safety check. One node command, and it runs on your computer. Includes 150 editable skills and Brief. One payment: $79 until Oct 31, 2026 (11:59 pm Pacific), then $149.

products.name: Pixel Soup
products.tagline: Dithered live wallpapers your Mac cooks up itself
products.summaryZh: 你的 Mac 自己生成的抖动动态壁纸
products.descriptionZh: Pixel Soup 为你的 Mac 自动生成壁纸。选择形状、配色和抖动风格，它便会在 GPU 上实时绘制，随后在图标背后缓缓流动，或定格为静态图像。放入照片，它也能对其应用抖动效果。一键随机生成新壁纸，或让它每小时推送一张新壁纸。免费试用 3 天，无需账户，无需信用卡。之后一次付费，无订阅。
products.description: Pixel Soup makes your Mac's wallpaper for you. Pick a shape, a palette and a dither style, and it draws it live on your GPU, then keeps it gently moving behind your icons or freezes it as a still. Drop in a photo and it dithers that too. Hit one button for a random new wallpaper, or let it serve a fresh one every hour. Free to try for 3 days, no account and no card. Then one payment, no subscription.

products.name: Art4
products.tagline: Small Art Museum for your Mac
products.summaryZh: 为你的 Mac 打造的小型艺术博物馆
products.descriptionZh: 你喜欢莫奈的花园，还是梵高的天空？Art4 是一款 Mac 应用，把你的桌面变成一座微型博物馆。浏览经典艺术作品，阅读每幅画作的短篇故事，把心仪之作设为清晰、尺寸恰到好处的壁纸——一次买断，无需订阅。
products.description: Do you like Monet’s gardens or Van Gogh’s skies? Art4 is a Mac app that turns your desktop into a tiny museum. Browse classic artworks, read short stories about each piece, and set your favorites as sharp, perfectly sized wallpapers—one-time purchase, no subscription.

products.name: FlexChords
products.tagline: Turn any YouTube video into accurate, playable guitar chords
products.summaryZh: 将任何YouTube视频转换为准确、可演奏的吉他和弦
products.descriptionZh: FlexChords 可将任意 YouTube 视频或音频文件在数秒内转换为准确、同步的吉他和弦。不同于预测嘈杂或设有付费墙的工具，FlexChords 将深度学习与乐理平滑相结合，消除杂音，呈现干净、富有音乐性的和弦进行。功能包括 YouTube 与音频和弦检测、同步播放与实时和弦、带和弦编辑器的交互式时间轴、调性与速度估计。即时访问无限曲库歌曲 + 每月 5 次免费自定义扫描。
products.description: FlexChords turns any YouTube video or audio file into accurate, synchronized guitar chords in seconds. Unlike tools with noisy predictions or paywalls, FlexChords pairs deep learning with music-theory smoothing to eliminate glitches and deliver clean, musical progressions. Features include YouTube & audio chord detection, synced playback & real-time chords, interactive timeline with chord editor, key & tempo estimation. Instant access to unlimited catalog songs + 5 free custom scans (per month).

products.name: Gemini 4 Argon
products.tagline: Google's frontier model for careful reasoning & complex work
products.summaryZh: 谷歌的前沿模型，用于审慎推理和复杂工作
products.descriptionZh: Gemini 4 Argon 是 Google 面向复杂、长周期专业工作的前沿 AI 模型。它融合了高级推理、编码、多模态理解与网络安全防御能力，支持最多 100 万输出 token。它面向软件工程、金融、法律工作和企业研究而设计，帮助解决多步骤问题，同时 Google 通过可信测试和安全保障逐步扩大访问范围。
products.description: Gemini 4 Argon is Google’s frontier AI model for complex, long-horizon professional work. It combines advanced reasoning, coding, multimodal understanding, and cybersecurity-defense capabilities, with support for up to 1 million output tokens. Designed for software engineering, finance, legal work, and enterprise research, it helps solve multi-step problems while Google gradually expands access through trusted testing and safety safeguards.

products.name: Capybara Court
products.tagline: Tiny disputes, gently settled by a capybara judge
products.summaryZh: 小小的争执，由水豚法官温和调解
products.descriptionZh: 两个人回答关于一场小纠纷的同样四个问题。双方内容各自封存，只有水豚法官卡皮能同时看到两边。裁决会在两部手机上同时打开，过错从不是100比0。独自一人？发到画廊，名字遮盖。一切内容30天后粉碎。
products.description: Two people answer the same four questions about a small dispute. Each side is sealed; only Judge Cappy, a capybara, reads both. The ruling opens on both phones at once, fault never 100 to 0. Alone? Post to the gallery, names covered. It all shreds in 30 days.
